Application Data.NAME: Bella Botanicals, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Bella Botanicals, LLC specializes in the retail of high-quality, natural skincare products formulated from botanical ingredients. Our operations include a well-curated selection of moisturizers, serums, and cleansers that are sourced from reputable suppliers. We maintain an in-store inventory control system to ensure product quality and freshness while offering a limited selection of our products online through a secure e-commerce platform. All products undergo rigorous ingredient testing, and we comply with all applicable regulations to ensure safety and effectiveness. Our team is committed to transparency in labeling and marketing, clearly communicating the benefits and potential side effects of our products to our customers.

12. **No**: The applicant has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years.

**Decision:** REJECT  
**Rejection Reason:** This business is rejected due to violating a specific underwriting exclusion related to involvement in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, a customer reported an allergic reaction after using our face serum, resulting in a claim for medical expenses totaling $5,000. The claim is currently pending resolution as we are gathering additional information to assess the validity of the claim. The product has been temporarily removed from our shelves for further testing.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade I, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure perimeter fencing and 24/7 monitored alarm system; regular security checks performed by contracted watchpersons to ensure a safe retail environment for customers and inventory.

Underwriting Guidelines:
Example: A boutique skincare retailer selling branded products with in-store inventory con-
trols and a secure website for limited online orders would be preferred. Conversely, a company
manufacturing thousands of units monthly without documented ingredient testing or regulatory
certifications would be declined.
Key Risk Considerations
Cosmetics and toiletries businesses face several unique risk exposures
that must be carefully evaluated:
• Product Liability: Allergic reactions, skin irritation, or contamination can lead to bodily
injury claims. For example, a mislabeled ingredient causing anaphylaxis or a contaminated
batch resulting in widespread consumer illness.
• Advertising Injury: Claims arising from false advertising, misrepresentation of product
benefits, or failure to disclose potential side effects. For instance, a claim alleging deceptive
marketing of “organic” or “hypoallergenic” products.
